name: UP Rajma Masala
ingredients: Ginger, garlic, jeera and 1 tsp oil
steps: Add rajma and cooking liquid; simmer 15 minutes.
note: Pair with a measured portion of brown basmati rice and vegetables.

inspirationReferences.title: Rajma Recipe | Rajma Masala (Restaurant Style)
inspirationReferences.note: Kidney-bean soaking, pressure-cooking and gravy consistency as a baseline; our UP home-style seasoning is distinct.
